name: libris
description: A modern web-based library management system built with Django REST Framework and React, featuring book borrowing, donations, sales, and role-based access control.

scripts.backend: cd "Online Library Management System/library" && python manage.py runserver
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd react-frontend-olms && npm install && cd "../Online Library Management System/library" && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.migrate: cd "Online Library Management System/library" && python manage.py migrate
